description: A whole-site scan reads a representative sample of a site and needs a person with a Bot Appétit account, and an agent never creates one. This returns exactly what the person must do, in order: connect this agent to their account (a one-time approval in their browser), after which start_site_scan, site_scan_status, list_sites and the other account tools work. For a single page, use scan_page instead, which is free and needs no account.

url.description: The site the person wants scanned, if you know it. It is used only to word the steps.

name: request_site_scan
title: Ask for a whole-site scan
